name: Mayuzumi Taisei
source: Mayuzumi Yukie and Mayuzumi Sayaka's father. He is known as the Sword Saint and is considered to be a living treasure of Japan. He is terrible with technology to the extent that he has problems using cameras, remote controls, and other such electronics.
